metadata.heading_title: Of the Practice in granting and revoking Probates and Letters of Administration

heading.title: Of the Practice in granting and revoking Probates and Letters of Administration

article.title: Directions to executor or administrator.
article.content:
302Directions to executor or administrator.

Section 302  ·  Part IX · Chapter IV  ·  page 81 of the Act
Where probate or letters of administration in respect of any estate has or have been granted under this Act, the High Court may, on application made to it, give to the executor or administrator any general or special directions in regard to the estate or in regard to the administration thereof.
